# The Christian Science Monitor

> > Independent journalism covering US politics, world affairs, environment, culture, and books with Pulitzer Prize-winning reporting since 1908.

The Christian Science Monitor (CSMonitor.com) provides in-depth news analysis and investigative journalism on domestic and international issues, featuring award-winning coverage of politics, climate change, cybersecurity, and social issues. The Monitor offers podcasts, special multimedia series, and thoughtful commentary emphasizing constructive solutions journalism.

## Key Topics

- US Politics and Elections
- Climate Change and Clean Energy
- Renewable Energy Policy
- Migration and Belonging
- Cybersecurity and Privacy
- Investigative Journalism
- Republican Party Politics
- Joe Biden Administration
- International Affairs (Russia, Europe, Africa, Pakistan)
- Sarah Palin and 2008 Election
- Racial Justice and Reconciliation
- Environmental Sustainability
- Energy Transition (Oil & Gas to Renewables)
- Pulitzer Prize Journalism

## US Politics and Elections

- [Politics](https://www.csmonitor.com/USA/Politics): US politics coverage: Trump, Congress, elections, and policy
- [Sarah Palin - All coverage](https://www.csmonitor.com/USA/Topics/Sarah-Palin): Coverage of Sarah Palin, Alaska governor and 2008 VP candidate
- [Arkansas Senate race](https://www.csmonitor.com/USA/Elections/Topics/Arkansas-Senate-race): 2010 Arkansas Senate race: Boozman vs Lincoln coverage

## Environment and Energy

- [Energy Topics](https://www.csmonitor.com/Environment/Topics/Energy): Energy coverage including renewables, climate policy, and oil & gas
- [Energy News](https://www.csmonitor.com/Environment/Energy): Energy news: offshore wind, solar, nuclear, and Biden clean energy policy
- [Inhabit](https://www.csmonitor.com/Environment/Inhabit): Environmental journalism on climate, sustainability, and conservation

## Podcasts and Multimedia

- [Tulsa Rising](https://www.csmonitor.com/Podcasts/Tulsa-Rising): Podcast series on 1921 Tulsa Race Massacre and racial reconciliation
- [Why We Wrote This](https://www.csmonitor.com/Podcasts/Why-We-Wrote-This): Behind-the-scenes journalism podcast with Monitor reporters
- [Specials](https://www.csmonitor.com/Specials): Multimedia feature stories and investigative journalism series

## World Affairs and International Coverage

- [Security Culture](https://www.csmonitor.com/World/Passcode/Security-culture): Cybersecurity workforce, ethical hacking, and privacy coverage
- [Finding 'Home' Series](https://www.csmonitor.com/World/Topics/Finding-Home-An-occasional-series-exploring-what-it-means-to-belong): Series on migration, belonging, and community across Syria to Spain
- [Honduras Coverage](https://www.csmonitor.com/World/Topics/Honduras): Honduras coverage: migration, democracy, and Berta Cáceres activism
- [Ivory Coast Coverage](https://www.csmonitor.com/World/Topics/ivory-coast): Ivory Coast coverage: politics, ICC cases, and West African affairs

## Culture and Books

- [Books](https://www.csmonitor.com/Books): Book reviews, literary news, and weekly podcast from CSMonitor
- [Latest News Wires](https://www.csmonitor.com/The-Culture/Latest-News-Wires): Entertainment news wire feed covering film, box office, and culture

## Optional

- [Pulitzer Prizes](https://www.csmonitor.com/Specials/Monitor-Centennial/Pulitzer-Prizes): Monitor's Pulitzer Prize history featuring Clay Bennett and David Rohde
- [Comments & Testimonials](https://www.csmonitor.com/Specials/Monitor-Centennial/Comments-Testimonials): Testimonials from Mandela, McCain, FDR for Monitor's centennial
- [Give](https://www.csmonitor.com/About/Offer/Give): Gift subscription options for Monitor Daily and Weekly
